proves.claim: flow tune --apply, run as the coordinator with line.tune on and a due cycle, records exactly one line_setting event whose key and value are the ones chooseTuning returns from tuneFixes, with the reason and window tuneRecord builds.

cli.flow-tune.apply-one-change.why: Without it the line controller could name a change but never make it, so the board's own numbers could not move a setting.

proves.claim: flow tune --apply records the reverse change on the next due cycle when revertTuning says revert, prints a request-kind choice to the person without writing a setting, and writes no event with line.tune off or a cycle not due.

cli.flow-tune.revert-request-and-off.why: A tuned change must undo itself when it makes the constraint worse, and never write while the setting is off or a decision is the person's.
